title: FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit Interest Charges and Annual Fee
content:
Interest and the annual fee on FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit are charged on these terms.

**Interest.** Interest is charged at each statement closing on the average daily balance of the cycle (draws accrue from the draw date with no grace period) times the APR divided by 365 times the days in the cycle, rounded to the cent.

**APR.** The APR follows the Prime Rate index plus the tier margin, within the tier floor and the APR cap, changing from the first billing cycle after an index change; while AutoPay is active the APR is lowered by the tier's AutoPay discount.

**Annual fee.** The annual fee is charged only on a line in active or frozen status, as shown by Larkspur's record of that line at the time the fee falls due. It is charged on each anniversary of the open date, except the first anniversary where the tier waives the first year, and not at all on tiers with a 0.00 fee; a line in repayment is no longer charged an annual fee.

## Worked interest figure (hypothetical inputs)

A FlexLine line with an average daily balance of 3000.00 USD over a 30-day cycle at an APR of 18.00%: 3000.00 times 0.18 is 540.00; divided by 365 is 1.47945 a day; times 30 days is 44.3836, rounded to the cent 44.38 USD of interest charged at that statement closing.

## Annual fee on an anniversary, by line status and tier

| Line status on the anniversary | Tier annual fee 0.00 | Tier fee above 0.00, first anniversary, tier waives the first year | Tier fee above 0.00, any other anniversary |
|---|---|---|---|
| active | not charged | not charged | charged |
| frozen | not charged | not charged | charged |
| repayment | not charged | not charged | not charged |

*Hypothetical case:* a FlexLine Starter line, active on its first anniversary, is charged the tier's annual fee, because FlexLine Starter does not waive the first year; a FlexLine Plus line on its first anniversary is not, and on its second anniversary is.
